name: Ashtanga Yoga Shala, Hinwil (Jagadeesan Kamalan)
reason: Contact rule (owner, 11 Nov 2026): the site ashtanga-shala.com (robots.txt allows us) is a real shala in Hinwil-Hadlikon with Mysore and led classes and published CHF prices, but its only email addresses are script-obfuscated mailto links (scrambled tokens in place of the @), which are never decoded, and it has no contact form; a phone/WhatsApp number alone fails the contact rule. Its pages also sell Kalari massage and describe the practice as detoxifying the blood.
